hub.vacio: No workouts yet. Log the first one.

carrera.sinObjetivo: No race in sight. Set one and the system builds your plan.
carrera.hoyA11y: {{nombre}}: today is the day. See the plan
carrera.faltanA11y_one: {{nombre}}: {{count}} day to go. See the plan
carrera.faltanA11y_other: {{nombre}}: {{count}} days to go. See the plan
carrera.cumplida: Race done. Choose the next one.

hoyToca.libre: No session in the plan today

salida.sinUbicacion: Set your city and the system checks the weather for you.

estado.no_aplica: Today does not depend on the weather

motivoSuave.forma_riesgo: Your load is well above usual.

motivoDescanso.riesgo: A lot of load and little rest at once.

motivoSinVentana.clima: The weather is not good in any slot.
motivoSinVentana.horario: It does not fit in what is left of the day.

derivacion.cuerpo: The system does not assess pain. See a healthcare professional before training again. If it is intense, or there is chest pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, call emergency services.

detalle.sin_datos: Log workouts and you will see your curve here.
detalle.fresco: Rested. There is room to load.
detalle.productivo: Form is rising and fatigue is under control.
detalle.cargado: Fatigue is building up. Watch your rest.
detalle.riesgo: You raised the load too fast. Ease off.

bienestar.abrirA11y: Note today’s sleep, fatigue and pain

ubicacion.guarda: The name of the city you choose and its coordinates. The phone’s GPS is not used.
ubicacion.para: Only to check the weather forecast and suggest when to go out.
ubicacion.precision: Coordinates rounded to two decimals: the area of the city, about a kilometre, never your home.
ubicacion.tercero: Open-Meteo, the weather service, receives what you search for and those coordinates, without your name or account.
ubicacion.retirada: From this same sheet, whenever you want. The city is deleted and you stop seeing “When to go out”.
ubicacion.acepto: I agree that NIVL stores my city for this

hoja.errorDesnivel: That elevation gain is not possible.
hoja.errorGuardar: The system could not save this workout.
hoja.otraSesionTitulo: There is already a {{deporte}} workout that day
hoja.otraSesionCuerpo: If it is the same one, do not log it again: it would count twice.

detalle.zonasSinPerfil: To see your zones, set your maximum heart rate.
detalle.borrarMensaje: It leaves your history and your form. That day’s XP does not change.

entrada.cuerpo: Running, cycling and swimming: your form, your plan and when to go out.

pulso.ayuda: This is all it takes. If you do not know it, use the highest you have seen in a hard workout.

anuncioXp.corrige: The system corrects the record. The XP for this session was already paid.
anuncioXp.tope: Noted. You have reached today’s XP cap: the session still counts for your study.
anuncioXp.yaMarcada: Noted. Today’s mission was already marked and paid.
anuncioXp.maximo: Noted. You have already earned today’s cardio maximum ({{tope}} XP), but the session still counts for your study.
anuncioXp.otroDia: Saved. It's from another day: it counts for your analysis, not for today's XP.
anuncioXp.yaConstaba: Saved. That session was already logged today and won't pay again: it counts for your analysis.
